summary: The Board is approving a contract with Bay Area Community Resources to hire and pay four Student Support Specialists who, under school staff supervision, give academic mentoring, tutoring and study-skills help to pathway students at Oakland Technical High School. The cost is capped at $304,750 for July 1, 2019 through June 30, 2020.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Professional Services Contract - Michelle Campbell-Mateo - Edna Brewer Middle School
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a Professional Services Contract between the District and Michelle Campbell-Mateo, Oakland, CA, for the latter to provide restorative justice support as well as mentoring at-risk students and related services, as described in the Scope of Work, incorporated herein by reference as though fully set forth, at Edna Brewer Middle School, for the period of August 1, 2019 through May 29, 2020, in an amount not to exceed $45,000.00.
headline: Ratifies up to $45,000 for a restorative justice and mentoring contractor at Edna Brewer Middle School
summary: The Board is approving, after the contract period began, a contract with an individual in Oakland to provide restorative justice support (conflict-resolution practices) and mentoring for at-risk students at Edna Brewer Middle School. The cost is capped at $45,000 for August 1, 2019 through May 29, 2020.

title: Professional Services Contract - Bay Area Community Resources - Fremont High School
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of a Professional Services Contract between the District and Bay Area Community Resources, San Rafael, CA, for the latter to on-board and pay three (3) Student Support Specialists from BACR, under school staff supervision to  provide academic mentoring support to pathway students identified by appropriate school staff in the form of tutoring, study skills, organizational support, and provide related services, as described in the Scope of Work, incorporated herein by reference as though fully set forth, at Fremont High School, for the period of August 12, 2019 through May 28, 2020, in an amount not to exceed $244,375.00.
headline: Pays Bay Area Community Resources up to $244,375 for three student mentors at Fremont High
summary: Bay Area Community Resources, a nonprofit based in San Rafael, will hire and pay three Student Support Specialists to mentor pathway students at Fremont High School. They will offer tutoring, study skills and organizational help under school staff supervision. The contract runs from August 12, 2019 through May 28, 2020.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Professional Services Contract - OCCUR - Sojourner Truth Independent Study Program
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a Professional Services Contract between the District and OCCUR, Oakland, CA, for the latter to provide professional development for all teachers in order to equip them with essential Career Technology Education skills to enhance student curriculum and increase student engagement in Technology Pathway at Sojourner Truth Independent Study Program, for the period of August 12, 2019 through May 29, 2020, in an amount not to exceed $10,000.00.
headline: Ratifies up to $10,000 for OCCUR to train Sojourner Truth teachers in career technology skills
summary: OCCUR, an Oakland organization, will provide professional development so all teachers at Sojourner Truth Independent Study Program can build career technology education skills for the school's Technology Pathway. The contract runs from August 12, 2019 through May 29, 2020. The Board is approving it after the start date, which is called ratification.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Professional Services Contract - Educational Equity For All - Special Education Department
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a Professional Services Contract between the District and Educational Equity For All, Pomona, CA, for the latter to provide two days of professional development workshops for Special Education Teachers, entitled “Collaboration for Inclusive Practices”, on July 31 2019 and “Implementing Best Practices In a Moderate To Severe Classroom” on August 1, 2019, via Special Education Department, for the period of July 1, 2019 through September 30, 2019, in an amount not to exceed $1,908.00.
headline: Ratifies $1,908 for Educational Equity For All's two special education teacher workshops
summary: Educational Equity For All, based in Pomona, ran two days of professional development workshops for special education teachers, on July 31 and August 1, 2019. The topics were inclusive practices and teaching students with moderate to severe disabilities. The contract period is July 1 through September 30, 2019, and the Board is approving it after the work took place.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Professional Services Contract - Philip Williams - Edna Brewer Middle School
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a Professional Services Contract between the District and Philip Williams, Oakland, CA, for the latter to provide technical assistance with Windows and Apple Macintosh computers, as required by school, to obtain the maximum instructional benefit and utility for students and staff including refinement and implementation upgrades to the plan for provision of printing capability in all classrooms and computer labs; design, execute and maintain a plan for printing from Chromebooks, for both staff and students and advise, support, repair, and troubleshoot the use of Chromebooks in the classroom; provide assistance in troubleshooting implementation issues with all software packages and applications, and  may be involved in further research, design development, and advice related to teaching strategies with computers, security and account configuration, as needed at Edna Brewer Middle School, for the period of August 1, 2019 through May 29, 2020, in an amount not to exceed $30,000.00.
headline: Ratifies up to $30,000 for a contractor's computer and Chromebook support at Edna Brewer Middle
summary: An Oakland contractor will give technical help with Windows and Apple computers and Chromebooks at Edna Brewer Middle School. The work includes printing setup, troubleshooting software and advising on security and account settings. The contract runs from August 1, 2019 through May 29, 2020, and the Board is approving it after the start date.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Professional Services Contract - Jose Garcia - Rudsdale Newcomer High School
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a Professional Services Contract between the District and Jose Garcia, Oakland, CA, for the latter to teach an art based wellness class “Young Hawks” for most at risk youth during first period; case manage those students to increase their pass rate in all academic classes; provide trauma informed training for staff as well as develop pathway aligned cultural activities that improve school overall culture and climate and maintain a safe environment for everyone at Rudsdale Newcomer High School, for the period of August 5, 2019 through July 30, 2020, in an amount not to exceed $54,978.00.
headline: Ratifies up to $54,978 for a wellness class and case management at Rudsdale Newcomer High
summary: An Oakland contractor will teach an art-based wellness class called "Young Hawks" for at-risk students at Rudsdale Newcomer High School. The contractor will also case-manage those students to help them pass their classes, train staff in trauma-informed practices and plan activities that improve school culture. The contract runs from August 5, 2019 through July 30, 2020, and the Board is approving it after the start date.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Professional Services Contract - Stephanie Villatoro - Rudsdale Newcomer High School
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a Professional Services Contract between the District and Stephanie Villatoro, Oakland, CA, for the latter to provide intensive academic tutoring before and after school as well as instructional support in academic classes during the school day, including study hall, English speaking support, teach an English Conversation elective course on Wednesdays and participate in the COST team’s focus on getting all students to school on time every day at Rudsdale Newcomer High School, for the period of August 12, 2019 through May 29, 2020, in an amount not to exceed $29,992.00.
headline: Ratifies up to $29,992 for a tutor and class support at Rudsdale Newcomer High
summary: An Oakland contractor will provide tutoring before and after school and support in classes during the day at Rudsdale Newcomer High School. The work includes help with English speaking, an English Conversation elective on Wednesdays and work on getting students to school on time. The contract runs from August 12, 2019 through May 29, 2020, and the Board is approving it after the start date.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Professional Services Contract - The Teaching Well - Rudsdale Continuation High School
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a Professional Services Contract between the District and The Teaching Well, Santa Rosa, CA, for the latter to provide 9 hours of professional development that builds teachers skills on the nexus of work life balance; 30 minute 1-1 mentoring twice per month for 14 staff members to improve their sustainability, resilience and emotional intelligence so that they can better serve students and community at Rudsdale Continuation High School, for the period of August 1, 2019 through May 29, 2020, in an amount not to exceed $16,800.00.
headline: Ratifies up to $16,800 for The Teaching Well's work-life balance training at Rudsdale Continuation High
summary: The Teaching Well, based in Santa Rosa, will give 9 hours of professional development on work-life balance. It will also hold 30-minute one-on-one mentoring sessions twice a month for 14 staff members at Rudsdale Continuation High School. The contract runs from August 1, 2019 through May 29, 2020, and the Board is approving it after the start date.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Professional Services Contract - Sandra Wilson - Elmhurst United Middle School
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a Professional Services Contract between the District and Sandra Wilson, Oakland, CA, for the latter to provide direct on-site services for the school’s Peer Restorative Justice (RJ) Program by collaborating with site staff to identify and recruit 10-15 peer RJ youth leaders (11-14 years old) that reflect the racial, ethnic, and academic diversity of the school; organize, create, and design training materials that teach conflict resolution, effective communication, problem solving, and restorative practices, and to share them with the Peer RJ coordinators; have Peer RJ leaders work in pairs to help peers involved in a dispute to resolve their differences and repair their relationship; coach the peer RJ leaders to conduct an average of 25-30 restorative circles to respond to harm or conflict and support the school site in creating a safe, healthy and supportive environment at Elmhurst United Middle School, for the period of August 12, 2019 through May 31, 2020, in an amount not to exceed $9,990.00.
headline: Ratifies up to $9,990 for a peer restorative justice program at Elmhurst United Middle
summary: An Oakland contractor will run the Peer Restorative Justice Program at Elmhurst United Middle School. The contractor will recruit and train 10 to 15 student leaders, ages 11 to 14, to help classmates resolve disputes and lead restorative circles. The contract runs from August 12, 2019 through May 31, 2020, and the Board is approving it after the start date.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Nonpublic, Nonsectarian School/Agency Services Master Contract(s) - Summitview Child & Family Services, Inc. - 2019-2020 School Year - Special Education Department
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of Special Education Services Non-Public, Nonsectarian School/Agency Services Master Contract between the District and Summitview Child & Family Services, Inc., Placerville, CA, for the latter to provide services to pupils as specified in Section 1 of Contract, for the period July 1, 2019 through June 30, 2020, pursuant to terms and conditions of Resolution No. 1920-0151.
headline: Approves Summitview Child & Family Services' 2019-20 nonpublic school and agency contract
summary: This is a master contract with Summitview Child & Family Services, Inc., of Placerville, to provide services to students with special education needs who are placed in a nonpublic school or agency. The contract runs from July 1, 2019 through June 30, 2020 under Board Resolution No. 1920-0151. The official text does not state a dollar amount.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Memorandum of Understanding - District and San Francisco Unified School District - Student Placement for Services - Special Education Department
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of Memorandum of Understanding between the District and San Francisco Unified School District, San Francisco, CA, for the latter to provide special education placement and related services for a multiple disabilities resident pupil of the District, pursuant to the requirements of the IEP, for the 2019-20 School Year (for the period of August, 2019 through June, 2020), in an amount not to exceed $104,190.00.
headline: Pays San Francisco Unified up to $104,190 to serve one Oakland student with multiple disabilities
summary: Under a memorandum of understanding (a written agreement between agencies), San Francisco Unified School District will provide special education placement and related services for one Oakland student with multiple disabilities. The services follow the student's Individualized Education Program (IEP), the plan that spells out the services a student with a disability receives. The agreement covers the 2019-20 school year, August 2019 through June 2020.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: District Supplemental Annuity Plan for Classified Employees - Trustee [Representative] Appointments - Sherman Phillips and Melisha Linzie - Representing AFSCME, Local 257
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of the appointment of Sherman Phillips and Melisha Linzie, each as a Trustee [Representative] of the District Supplemental Annuity Plan for Classified Employees, representing American Federation of State County and Municipal Employees (AFSCME) Local 257, effective March 29, 2019.
headline: Ratifies two AFSCME Local 257 trustees for the classified employees' supplemental annuity plan
summary: The Board is confirming the appointment of two representatives of AFSCME Local 257, a union of public employees, as trustees of the District Supplemental Annuity Plan for Classified Employees. The appointments took effect March 29, 2019, before this vote. The item does not state any cost.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Professional Services Contract - School Services of California - Communications Department
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a Professional Services Contract between the District and School Services of California, Sacramento, CA, for the latter to work in a proactive manner to protect and advance the District's interest in Sacramento including developing strategies, monitoring legislation that may impact District and lobbying the Legislature and State Administration; schedule necessary meetings with local leadership, as well as coordinate legislative meetings for the Board of Education, and/or members thereof, and District staff travelling to Sacramento, via Communications Department, for the period of July 1, 2019 through June 30, 2020, in an amount not to exceed $54,158.00.
headline: Ratifies $54,158 for School Services of California to lobby and track legislation in Sacramento
summary: School Services of California, based in Sacramento, will work to protect and advance the District's interests with state lawmakers and the state administration. It will develop strategies, monitor legislation, lobby, and set up meetings for Board members and District staff who travel to Sacramento. The contract covers July 1, 2019 through June 30, 2020, and the Board is approving it after the start date.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Professional Services Contract - Kevin Del Angel - Board of Education - District 5 Director - Roseann Torres
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of a Professional Services Contract between the District and Kevin Del Angel, for latter to serve as consultant to District 5 Director, taking notes at community forums, coordination of events, planning, attend PTA meetings, parent forms and report back to Director; send emails and meet with organizations interested in serving District students, for period of September 26, 2019 through April 30, 2020, in an amount not to exceed $2,500.00.
headline: Pays a consultant up to $2,500 to support the District 5 school board director's community outreach
summary: A consultant will assist the District 5 Board Director by taking notes at community forums, helping coordinate events, attending PTA and parent meetings and reporting back to the director. The consultant will also meet with organizations that want to serve District students. The contract runs from September 26, 2019 through April 30, 2020.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
